name: Remediate 500 Error on Unicode Emojis in Order Instructions
task_description: Fix bug where submitting an order with unicode emojis (e.g. 📦) in shipping instructions causes an uncaught database encoding error and HTTP 500 response.

guardrails.require_architecture_and_history_first: Inspect system encoding architecture and review git history (git log -S, git blame) before editing code
guardrails.prohibit_premature_patching: Never apply speculative edits or guess root causes without an automated failing reproduction test
guardrails.enforce_surgical_diff: Apply minimal blast-radius changes (<2 min reviewable, zero unrelated formatting changes)
guardrails.prioritize_internal_reuse: Check existing encoding and serialization utilities before writing custom string handlers
guardrails.enforce_compound_learning_loop: Record failure mechanism and institutionalize defect prevention in test suite and completion report

invariants: Do not guess root cause; inspect git history and write automated reproduction test first
